reviewMethod: All 15 selected stored files across the next five priority-eligible current-corpus papers were independently rehashed against the fresh immutable read-only GitHub evidence artifact and checked for exact task/page/article/source DOI identity, original Figure/Scheme identity and independent caption, captureVersion/job identity, fixed media generation 1790082000000, content-addressed R2 key, actual byte length/type/dimensions, duplicate source/hash ownership, frozen public same-ID state and TOC separation. The eleven SVG files were parsed, rendered and checked for script, foreignObject, event-handler, javascript/external href and external CSS URL content; the four PNG files were decoded and dimension-checked. Every image was visually reviewed against its owning caption and article theme for body-image role, unrelated/recommendation contamination, duplicate risk and legibility. The five already-reviewed but still-unmerged PR #208 DOI encountered between the fresh JACS and later candidates were reused as prior decisions and skipped rather than reviewed again. Capture success, partial, transport and format checkpoints were treated only as provenance evidence, not semantic approval. No publisher request, R2/D1 write, direct import/repair, literature/card/title/scope mutation, userscript change or media-generation change was performed.
quality: All 15 selected files are exact stored bytes with matching full SHA256, sizes and dimensions and no cross-DOI hash/source ownership collision in the frozen stage inventory. Public media-index evidence contained a distinct official TOC and no same-ID body figure for each selected DOI. JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c14601 remains article-level partial 1/6, JACS 10.1021/jacs.6c16323 remains partial 1/6, and JOC 10.1021/acs.joc.6c01347 remains partial 2/8, so only the exact reviewed stored files are approved and missing images are not inferred. Organic Letters 10.1021/acs.orglett.6c03373 has a final 5/5 capture and ACS Catalysis 10.1021/acscatal.6c05820 has a final 6/6 capture. Historical transport/format checkpoints are retained only as provenance and are not interpreted as VPN, R2, quota or publisher failures. Figure 1 files are body-only and are not TOC substitutions; existing official TOCs remain untouched.
